verdict.rationale: Mangopay documents payouts in 24+ currencies and smart routing that always uses the domestic rail when currency and country match, which covers local-currency payouts and settlement on local rails rather than wires. FX handling is backed only by a one-line marketing claim about embedding FX conversions, with no documented rates, markups, or conversion mechanics. missing for 10: detailed FX handling documentation (rates/fees/conversion flow), a list of supported local rails per corridor, and independent or hands-on corroboration of payout routing.

support.subject: As a finance lead, international sellers get paid properly — local-currency payouts, documented FX handling, and settlement to local bank rails rather than expensive wires

citations.quote: Send funds locally and internationally in 24+ currencies
Mangopay applies a smart routing logic to always use the domestic rail if a local currency is sent, thereby optimizing routing costs and speeds
Mangopay always attempts to use the domestic rail if the currency and country correspond.
Reach global markets by seamlessly embedding FX conversions in your workflow
